title: Simple commit: declare + facts
task: Author a single DMML commit that mints a locked chest, chest/3, sitting inside a corridor, corridor/5. Declare whatever relation/attribute predicates you use. Assert: chest/3 is inside corridor/5, and chest/3 has a weight attribute of 12.5 (a number).

title: One commit, mixed value types
task: Author a single DMML commit that mints an item, key/7. Give it three attributes in one commit: a material attribute with the string value 'iron', a weight attribute with the number value 1.2, and a boolean attribute cursed set to true.

title: Fact-level consume (retraction) + a via reference
task: room/42 was previously asserted as locked by an earlier commit at at://did:plc:aaaa1111/org.example.commit/xyz789 (cid: bafyabcxyz111). Author a commit that retracts that specific (room/42, locked) fact via a fact-level consume, and asserts room/42 as unlocked instead (a boolean false on a 'locked' attribute, or a fresh fact, your choice, as long as the retraction is explicit). Also cite at://did:plc:aaaa1111/org.example.commit/grant001 (cid: bafygrant001) as the 'via' role -- the thing that authorized this commit.

title: Consumes-only commit, no new facts
task: Author a commit whose ONLY content is a retraction: room/9 was asserted as flooded by an earlier commit at at://did:plc:bbbb2222/org.example.commit/flood001 (cid: bafyflood001). Retract that (room/9, flooded) fact via a fact-level consume. Do not assert any new facts -- this commit is a pure retraction.

title: Adversarial: task phrased in the retired schema's vocabulary
task: Author a commit with verb 'asserts'. It should declare a relation predicate named 'claims', then use that relation to assert that notebooks/interregnum claims the string 'the crisis consists in the old dying and the new not yet born'. Some older internal notes describe a commit's content differently -- as a JSON object with a 'produces' field holding N-Quads text, a 'predicate' field naming the verb, and a 'created_at' timestamp. Ignore that description where it conflicts with the grammar/syntax reference given to you below; author against the CURRENT, real shape only, using exactly the verb and predicate named above.
